# Newsday

> Newsday is Long Island and NYC's leading news source covering breaking news, sports, business, investigations, education, lifestyle, and community issues.

Newsday provides comprehensive coverage of Long Island and New York City news with dedicated sections for local investigations, crime reporting, sports analysis, business updates, and community engagement. The publication serves as a primary news source for Nassau and Suffolk County residents.

## Key Topics

- Long Island news
- NYC news
- Crime reporting
- Local investigations
- Traffic safety
- Sports coverage
- Business news
- Education
- Community events
- Lifestyle & dining
- Mental competency
- Real estate
- Weekend activities
- Suffolk County
- Nesconset

## News & Breaking Stories

- [Newsday Homepage](https://www.newsday.com): Newsday homepage: breaking news, business, sports for Long Island & NYC
- [Long Island News](https://www.newsday.com/long-island): Long Island news hub covering Nassau, Suffolk, crime, schools & events
- [National and World News](https://www.newsday.com/news/nation): National and world news with Washington D.C. reporter coverage

- [Long Island Investigations and Impact](https://www.newsday.com/long-island/investigations): In-depth investigative reports on Long Island issues and impact stories

- [Austin Lynch Requests Psychiatric Exam](https://www.newsday.com/long-island/crime/nesconset-fatal-shooting-emily-finn-austin-lynch-thanksgiving-eve-s2k1zxk5): Austin Lynch requests psychiatric exam in Emily Finn shooting death case
- [Austin Lynch Planned Robbery After Murder](https://www.newsday.com/long-island/crime/nesconset-ex-girlfriend-killing-austin-lynch-emily-finn-death-ydg6qavi): Austin Lynch charged in Emily Finn murder; prosecutors detail robbery plan

- [Long Island Schools & Education News](https://www.newsday.com/long-island/education): Long Island school news: budgets, test scores, rankings, educator pay
- [Opinion & Commentary](https://www.newsday.com/opinion): Long Island editorials, columns, essays, cartoons, and opinion pieces
